architecture.name: QueryConditionedTableMemory
architecture.description: Original tied residual block sees all events except the final query; a shared 128-to-64 row-logit decoder predicts the 8x8 A-table, then the final 8-way query one-hot selects its row. The query is a designed readout route, not evidence of emergent binding.
architecture.table_supervision: Train-only A-table eight-row cross entropy; source first-event input supplies table bits

criterion: At fixed 1920 updates: table-supervised arm train accuracy >=0.90 and calibration accuracy >=0.70; compare matched task-only arm. Failed gate reported as FAIL.
metrics: per-arm train/calibration task CE, task accuracy, eight-row exact table reconstruction accuracy, source SHA, checkpoint SHA, parameter count
scope: single seed CPU feasibility only; no sealed labels, causal observer claims or cross-family generalization
next_if_pass: freeze task model and register an independent causal observer/real rule edit comparison, with full null cards and same-dose controls
next_if_fail: publish result; any architecture modification gets a dated subsequent protocol
